title: SolarVision AI — Photovoltaic Manufacturing Root Cause Taxonomy
description: Standardized 9-class SEMI root-cause taxonomy with engineering cause codes, physical mechanisms, and failure analysis laboratory diagnostic procedures.

categories.physical_mechanism: Excessive soldering tip temperature (>250°C), thermal ramp rate (>15°C/s), or preheating delta (>30°C) inducing thermal shock and localized thermo-mechanical stresses between copper ribbon and silicon substrate during eutectic solidification.
categories.laboratory_verification_method: Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) along ribbon bond pad cross-section; acoustic micro-imaging revealing sub-surface delamination; infrared thermography under reverse bias.

categories.physical_mechanism: Squeegee downward force drifting away from nominal 18.0 N/cm² or uneven pneumatic pressure across blade length, resulting in paste bleeding (excess force) or discontinuous finger metallization (insufficient force).
categories.laboratory_verification_method: Optical 3D surface profilometry measuring contact finger aspect ratio (height-to-width) and line resistance measurements via 4-point probe transmission line model (TLM).

categories.physical_mechanism: Partial or complete aperture obstruction in stainless steel mesh due to dried silver paste particles, emulsion breakdown, or particulate contamination, blocking paste transfer onto wafer.
categories.laboratory_verification_method: Automated optical inspection (AOI) of screen mesh apertures; high-magnification optical microscopy of recurring missing finger coordinates across consecutive prints.

categories.physical_mechanism: Peak firing temperature exceeding silver paste alloy eutectic window (>870°C) or conveyor belt speed drop, leading to excessive silver crystallite penetration through the emitter junction (shunting / junction punch-through).
categories.laboratory_verification_method: Dark Lock-in Thermography (DLIT) revealing localized ohmic shunts; cross-sectional Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) measuring silver spike depth into emitter layer.

categories.physical_mechanism: Excessive vacuum cup differential (>80 kPa), robotic end-effector deceleration spike (>2.0 G), or misalignment during cassette transfer inducing micro-fissures along crystalline cleavage planes.
categories.laboratory_verification_method: High-resolution Photoluminescence (PL) imaging under low injection level; acoustic emission sensors installed on robot transfer arms; micro-Raman spectroscopy of edge crack tip strain fields.

categories.physical_mechanism: Uneven flexible diaphragm inflation pressure, vacuum chamber leak, or localized platen heater element failure during EVA/POE cross-linking cycle, exerting non-uniform mechanical bending moment across cell strings.
categories.laboratory_verification_method: Module-level Electroluminescence (EL) before and after lamination; Pressurex tactile pressure-indicating sensor film across platen bed during calibration run.

categories.physical_mechanism: Radial or axial thermal gradient instability in Czochralski (CZ) silicon ingot puller causing crystallographic slip dislocations, oxygen precipitate clustering, or point defect agglomeration during crystal growth.
categories.laboratory_verification_method: Sopori etch pit density (EPD) analysis; lifetime mapping via microwave-detected photoconductive decay (μ-PCD); Fourier Transform Infrared (FTIR) interstitial oxygen concentration measurement.

categories.physical_mechanism: Silicate accumulation, metal ion contamination (Fe, Cu), or bath temperature drop in alkaline KOH/IPA texturing tanks, resulting in non-uniform random pyramid etching and poor passivation layer adherence.
categories.laboratory_verification_method: Spectroscopic ellipsometry measuring anti-reflective coating refractive index and thickness uniformity; Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) surface metal trace analysis.

categories.physical_mechanism: Statistical common-cause variation within 3-sigma process control limits; cell defects caused by minor stochastic wafer surface interactions without an assignable machine excursion.
categories.laboratory_verification_method: Statistical Process Control (SPC) Shewhart control chart audit verifying that all machine telemetry channels remained within upper/lower control limits (UCL/LCL) for preceding 60 minutes.
